name: Bilibili
description: Bilibili video, series, and subscription support for FluxDown.

settings.title: Import Bilibili Cookies
settings.description: Authentication used during parsing. Accepts a browser Cookie header or Netscape cookies.txt; saved for subsequent parsing and downloads.

en.title: Import Bilibili Cookies
en.description: Authentication used during parsing. Accepts a browser Cookie header or Netscape cookies.txt; saved for subsequent parsing and downloads.

zh-Hans.title: 导入 Bilibili Cookie
zh-Hans.description: 解析时使用的登录态。支持浏览器 Cookie 头或 Netscape cookies.txt；保存后会用于后续解析与下载。

settings.title: Include Extras and Behind-the-Scenes
settings.description: Shared by series lists and series subscriptions. When off, lists only main episodes and excludes previews; when on, also lists extras, previews, PVs, interviews, and other sections.

en.title: Include Extras and Behind-the-Scenes
en.description: Shared by series lists and series subscriptions. When off, lists only main episodes and excludes previews; when on, also lists extras, previews, PVs, interviews, and other sections.

zh-Hans.title: 包含番外与花絮
zh-Hans.description: 番剧清单与番剧订阅共用：关闭时只列正片并排除预告；开启后同时列出番外、预告、PV、采访等分区。

settings.title: Prefer Highest Quality
settings.description: Shared by series lists and series/UP creator subscriptions: show only the highest available quality for each video.

en.title: Prefer Highest Quality
en.description: Shared by series lists and series/UP creator subscriptions: show only the highest available quality for each video.

zh-Hans.title: 优先最高画质
zh-Hans.description: 番剧清单及番剧、UP 主订阅共用：每个视频只展示最高可用画质。

settings.title: Default Quality
settings.description: Default quality for regular links and quality ceiling for series and UP creator subscriptions. Subscriptions do not support audio-only; audio-only is treated as best quality.

en.title: Default Quality
en.description: Default quality for regular links and quality ceiling for series and UP creator subscriptions. Subscriptions do not support audio-only; audio-only is treated as best quality.

zh-Hans.title: 默认画质
zh-Hans.description: 普通链接的默认画质，同时作为番剧和 UP 主订阅的画质上限。订阅不支持仅音频，选择仅音频时按最佳画质处理。

settings.title: Video Codec Preference
settings.description: Prefer the selected codec at the same quality; use a compatible codec at that quality if unavailable.

en.title: Video Codec Preference
en.description: Prefer the selected codec at the same quality; use a compatible codec at that quality if unavailable.

zh-Hans.title: 视频编码偏好
zh-Hans.description: 在同一画质优先选择指定编码；不可用时使用该画质的兼容编码。

settings.title: Audio Quality Preference
settings.description: For muxed audio/video and audio-only; if the selected tier is unavailable, prefer the nearest available tier.

en.title: Audio Quality Preference
en.description: For muxed audio/video and audio-only; if the selected tier is unavailable, prefer the nearest available tier.

zh-Hans.title: 音质偏好
zh-Hans.description: 适用于音画合并与仅音频；所选档位没有开放时优先降到最近可用档。
